items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Michael Martin. I’m not familiar with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, Joe did – he did a retake on, I think, It Happens Every Day.

It Happens Every Day, yeah. Michael Martin. I’m not familiar with him. Then some more with Don Sebesky. It looks like RCA Victor, a couple things. Dave Samuels, Larry Coryell, Eddie Gomez, Marty Morrell. Then Pat Williams, Sinatraland.
Yeah, I just did that recently. That’s about – that’s last year.
